master.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: 2D chibi desktop pet for Umeko, matching the EXISTING WHALE-GIRL PET.
Image 1 is the EXACT DRAWING STYLE AND BODY-PROPORTION REFERENCE. Match its Japanese 2D SD/chibi line art, compact approximately 2 to 2.3 heads-tall proportions, huge cute head, tiny body and little feet, flat cel colors, small simple shadow shapes, soft restrained highlights, clean dark outlines, big expressive anime eyes and tiny mouth. A small illustrated desktop sprite, not a rendered doll.
Image 2 is ONLY the DOUBAO CHARACTER IDENTITY AND CLOTHING reference. Keep the recognizable dark-brown chin-length side-parted asymmetrical short bob, black sweater, RED SCARF, tiny dark trousers and little dark ankle shoes. Reinterpret ALL of it in image 1's SIMPLE TWO-DIMENSIONAL ANIME STYLE. Replace the realistic detailed face with a sweet readable drawn chibi face: large warm brown anime eyes with a couple of simple highlights, minimal nose, tiny smiling mouth, light peach cheeks and small simplified hands. Hair is clean solid cel-shaded shapes, scarf and sweater are flat colors with just a few folds. Absolutely no individual hair strands, knit microtexture, skin pores, volumetric shading, photo lighting, realistic hands, glass doll eyes, 3D materials or toy-like render.
Pose: ONE complete full-body standing character, frontal with a slight three-quarter turn, hands softly together near waist, feet planted side by side, a relaxed friendly smile. Same compact visual silhouette as image 1, scaled to occupy about 80% of a SQUARE transparent canvas with safe empty margins around ALL hair, hands and shoes. Good readability at 192px.
GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY, no colored background or painted checkerboard. No scenery, floor, ground shadow, text, frame, symbols, speech bubbles, watermark or extra characters.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE transparent 4-COLUMN BY 3-ROW ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, exactly 12 sequential frames in row-major order. Preferred canvas 1536x1728; each of the 12 invisible grid cells is portrait 2:3. The reference is the APPROVED DOUBAO 2D CHIBI DESKTOP PET. Preserve her EXACT flat 2D anime line art, clean warm-dark outlines, simple cel colors and shadow shapes, huge expressive brown anime eyes, tiny smiling mouth, minimal nose, rosy cheeks, dark brown side-parted short bob, BLACK sweater and trousers, RED scarf and little dark ankle shoes. Same compact 2.3-head-tall SD proportions and beautiful cute face. No 3D shading, skin texture, knit microtexture, detailed realistic hands, glass doll eyes, dimensional hair strands, jewelry or new outfit. Every cell shows one COMPLETE independent full-body girl from hair to whole shoes, centered horizontally with clear transparent margins; shoes on the same relative baseline at 94% cell height. Precisely identical character SCALE and body proportions across ALL 12 cells. Both feet stay planted. Keep character separate between cells, no clipping or overlap. Motion must have real distinct smooth intermediate drawings, not twelve unrelated poses or repeated copies. Last frame approaches the first for a loop. Gentle secondary motion in short hair and scarf. Entire sheet background genuinely transparent alpha; no lines, separators, labels, numbers, floor, shadow, scene, text, watermark or extra objects. ACTION over frames 1 to 12: a gentle breathing and blink loop. Hands remain together near waist. Shoulders lift slightly through frames 2-4, tiny head tilt 4-6, eyes softly half-close 6 and close 7, reopen 8, head and shoulders gently settle through 9-12 into the starting pose. The tiny changes flow smoothly; preserve fixed foot positions and scale.
